localized_fixes.issue: The phrase rendered title material could imply visual rendering that this workflow did not establish.
localized_fixes.resolution: Changed to internal title and copyright text; no uploaded source was modified.

checks.name: Framework versus implementation attribution
checks.result: All six guides explicitly separate attributed concepts from original ClimbOS workflows, schemas, thresholds, examples and acceptance tests.

checks.name: Arithmetic
checks.result: Appointment funnel, spare capacity, typical/heavy-use contribution, 30% margin price floor, percentage-point versus relative lift and conversion-count examples recalculated successfully.

checks.name: Overgeneralization
checks.result: Guides retain context and exceptions: bounded-loss learning, qualitative evidence, provisional positioning, price discussion stages, low traffic, inconclusive outcomes, and current provider eligibility.

checks.name: Source provenance
checks.result: All six source hashes match uploads; all 36 locator paths and ranges resolve to extracted text. Claim scopes were spot-checked against the cited excerpts, including full checks of strategy-as-hypothesis, living business case, A/A tests and sample-ratio mismatch.

checks.name: Practical action
checks.result: Each guide provides a next-decision workflow, hypothetical application, record design, guardrails and acceptance criteria; each has two machine-readable playbooks.

checks.name: Playbook syntax and references
checks.result: All 12 JSON playbooks parse, contain the required fields, reference existing locators and retain proposed_reference status.

checks.name: Product boundaries
checks.result: No assumed prospect database, fabricated Formkit facts or deployed ClimbOS claims found in the reviewed scope.

limitations: This review read the guide prose and structured playbooks and checked cited excerpts; it is not an exhaustive line-by-line rereading of all six books.
Testing Business Ideas has layout-fragmented extraction; the guide records this and does not reconstruct missing visual ratings or a complete experiment catalog.
No fresh broad web research, runtime application audit, real customer experiment, legal review, or production integration test was performed.
Parseable reference contracts do not establish executable behavior; actual repository implementation and validation remain necessary.
